item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu from its Roman text, and check that the two versions align verse by verse.

item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Bachaya Hussain Ne Bilawal Ali Hussaini"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Jawad"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Bachaya Hussain Ne Bilawal Ali Hussaini
Deen Ki Baqa Hussain Badshah.
Sar De Ke Dein Khuda Ka Banaya Hussain Ne.
Wadah Khalil Ka Tha Nibhaya Hussain Ne.

2
Sadiyon Mein Anbiya Se Na Takmeel Ho Saki.
Jo Aik Din Mein Kar Ke Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
Banjar Thi Ik Umar Se Jo Arz-e-Karbala.
Oss Ko Mualla Aa Ke Banaya Hussain Ne.

3
Haq Ki Azan Ban Gayi Hal Min Ko Woh Sada.
Insan Ka Zameer Jagaya Hussain Ne.
Chehray Pe Mal Ke Ro Diye Be Sheer Ka Lahu.
Masoom Ka Youn Soag Manaya Hussain Ne.

4
Man Mein Bhuja Ke Apne Charagon Ki Roshni.
Islam Ke Diye Ko Jalaya Hussain Ne.
Mazlomiyat Ki Hai Yehi Jawad Inteha.
Khud Apne Qatilon Ko Rulaya Hussain Ne.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/bachaya-hussain-ne-bilawal-ali-hussaini-tajpoints-25c46f8ebb844e47032b.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---',2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert [s.casefold().rstrip('.') for s in old.splitlines()] == [s.casefold() for s in roman.splitlines()]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks] == list(numbers)
    assert [len(block)-1 for block in blocks] == [4]*4
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified Roman wording and four matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body, moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`, and verified that both versions have four stanzas of four verses each. Updated the title and right-to-left metadata, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I kept “Bilawal Ali Hussaini” as بلاول علی حسینی in both the title and opening verse, and read “Man” as من in stanza 4. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
